segments.normalizedSource: ```swift Chart(data) { LineMark( x: .value("date", $0.date), y: .value("price", $0.price) ) } .chartOverlay { proxy in GeometryReader { geometry in Rectangle().fill(.clear).contentShape(Rectangle()) .gesture( DragGesture() .onChanged { value in // Convert the gesture location to the coordinate space of the plot area. let origin = geometry[proxy.plotAreaFrame].origin let location = CGPoint( x: value.location.x - origin.x, y: value.location.y - origin.y ) // Get the x (date) and y (price) value from the location. let (date, price) = proxy.value(at: location, as: (Date, Double).self) print("Location: \(date), \(price)") } ) } } ```
